newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Gul Technologies IPO 135 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Gul Technologies IPO 135 times subscribed.

text.p: Printed circuit board maker Gul Technologies Singapore Ltd said on Friday the public tranche of its initial public offering (IPO) was 135 times subscribed.
Gul has offered 40.2 million shares at Singapore S$0.58 each to be listed on the second board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore. The public tranche comprised 20.01 million shares.
The placement tranche of 10.05 million shares was fully subscribed out and 10.05 million shares reserved for staff were also fully taken up, Gul said in a statement.
It said small investors -- those who applies for fewer than 9,000 shares -- would receive 48.51 percent of the public tranche .
Gul Technologies expects to start trading on Monday, March 17.
